lines: Welcome to the puppet show! Watch Pom. Then tap Next.
You're the puppeteer now. Change one thing at a time: Head, Voice or Bounce.
Puppets have feelings like we do. Tap a feeling.
How does Pom feel? Tell me. Then tap Show me.
Choose an ending. Tap Dot helps, A new kite, or Wait for the wind.
What do you see now? Say it. Then tap Audience says.
Only one thing changed, and the feeling changed!
This is Pom, a sock puppet. Pom has a brand new red kite.
Whoosh! The wind lifts the kite up high.
Oh no! The kite is stuck in the tall tree.
Pom tugs and tugs. The kite will not come down.
What happens next? Tap an ending.
Pom's friend Dot comes by with a long stick. Together they wiggle the kite free!
Pom finds paper and string, and makes a brand new kite, all by herself.
Pom sits under the tree and waits. A soft breeze drops the kite right down.
Some people like it when a friend helps.
Some people like it when you fix it yourself.
Some people like a quiet, patient ending.
